item.title: South Korea Ends 2017 Crypto Ban, Allows Institutions To Trade Bitcoin
item.description: South Korea is preparing to reopen its cryptocurrency market to corporate investors. According to Seoul Economic Daily, the Financial Services Commission (FSC) is revising its guidelines to allow crypto investments by listed companies and professional investors, effectively reversing a 2017 prohibition.Visit Website

item.title: Top YouTuber Says Cardano Risks Losing Relevance Without Hoskinson’s Public Presence
item.description: Crypto YouTuber Tim Warren has said the success of Cardano depends on the visibility and personal influence of its founder, Charles Hoskinson.
